method: Built-in image_gen, one generation per idea using opened local references for style; delivered as 1536×1024 WebP.

jobs.name: Base is the lobby
jobs.idea: Land in the chosen map’s own spawn area; a central shrine swaps heroes, and five ground spots assemble the party. The exit stays shut until everyone is ready.
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint one full-screen playable lobby concept for dodgethis, landscape 1536x1024. Steep 58-degree three-quarter top-down game camera, thin deliberate navy ink silhouettes, aquarelle palette, broad chalk/ceramic planes, spare underside hatching, paper grain, soft printed shadows, simple primitive-buildable geometry. Cream painted paper UI with wobbly navy edges, restrained hand-lettering. Small angular enamel/clay toy heroes, spare faces, no realistic humans, no glossy mobile-game rendering. Fletcher is an archer with bow and three quiver rods; Mitts has big boxing gloves; Brew a chunky potion vessel; Mender a slim healer carrying a megaphone; Hook carries a hook; Coach carries a whistle. Human heroes have names overhead and a thin foot ring. Bots are visibly translucent blue holograms with floor showing through and NO foot ring, no human names. Party capacity exactly FIVE, never opposing teams. Same party assembly serves Overthrow, Flagfall and Dungeon; destination ALREADY CHOSEN, do not show map selectors. Waiting is playing: show a friendly bonk with a small motion arc or playful running while others choose. Minimal UI. No health bars, combat HUD, ability hotbar, difficulty controls, team columns, old saucer lobby, huge title or ornamental RPG panels. These supplied references are style references only, not compositions to reproduce: lobby screenshot for camera/painted UI/holograms, built maps for practical ground geometry, Mender screenshot for actual heroes, splash tiles for palette and ink. ONLY IDEA: BASE IS THE LOBBY. OVERTHROW by day. Entire image is its actual spawn courtyard: pale green broad ground on a floating stone slab, blunt lavender low walls, peach cloud void and distant grass-topped pillars, small waterfall visible off edge. A blue faceted core behind the party grounds it unmistakably in the lane map. A small low glowing hero-swap shrine is the visual center, with simple bow/glove/megaphone emblems rotating above it; tiny paper tag 'SWAP'. EXACTLY FIVE spawn spots form a loose horseshoe around shrine: named solid Fletcher 'Oskar', named solid Mitts 'Ada', one translucent Mender bot, two faint empty floor circles with subtle plus signs. Humans may move off their marked spots to bonk, small connecting ink trail keeps ownership clear. The generous right-hand exit is CLOSED by a plain heavy two-leaf gate opening toward the single lane visible beyond; two small ready ticks and one waiting dot by gate read 'READY 2/3'. The solid humans are playfully bonking by shrine; bot stays at its spot. Tiny corner cream label 'OVERTHROW'. No menu seats, no row of cards, no GO button, no booths or campfire. Shrine, five spots and closed exit tell the whole story.

jobs.name: Draft over the map
jobs.idea: The chosen map fills the background, with hero cards above five party seats and one GO button. Along the bottom, the little party heroes can run around and bonk.

jobs.name: Merge: seats on top, plates on the floor
jobs.idea: Five party seats across the top open hero picking; matching stone plates keep the party visible on a playable Overthrow floor, with a lit portal into the lanes.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Paint ONE concept image, landscape exactly 1536x1024, for dodgethis's party lobby: "Merge: seats on top, plates on the floor". This is a playable party assembly after the map was already selected, for 1–5 seats, each human or bot and any hero. Waiting is playing.

Moebius ink line and big empty sky, Warhammer heft and wear, 90s Japanese PlayStation swagger: cute with an edge, never plush. Heroes are stylised low-poly primitives as built in the game, read from above by silhouette and one prop, each with a hard angle (horn, beak, blade, hooked claw), small eyes under a brow, worn hide, stone, cloth or enamel; no big glossy eyes, blush, rosy cheeks, chibi faces or mobile-card-game rendering. One navy ink, never black. Muted peach, sage, pale stone and violet; saturated colour only on team red and blue and Ball gold. Big shapes, little noise, one warm light, haze falling off with depth.

Camera and visual anchor: steep 58-degree three-quarter TOP-DOWN game camera, like the viewed lobby-1440.webp screenshot: mostly see roofs, shoulders and the floor, never eye-level portraits. Ground and stone use the broad flat simple primitive geometry of the viewed after-establishing.webp screenshot, not an elaborate fantasy illustration. References 04-campfire.webp and 05-menu-over-floor.webp are LAYOUT ONLY; their overly cute humanoid characters, Hearthstone treatment, detailed paving and ornamental scenery were rejected. Do not inherit their character style. Make angular geometric creatures with attitude, readable small from above, worn enamel/hide/stone, no rosy human faces, no pointy-hat storybook adventurers.

Setting: OVERTHROW BY DAY. A spacious pale stone and quiet sage ground platform, visible chipped faceted cliff sides in violet shadow, floating stone isles over warm cloud, peach sky and distant pale hazy pillars. One warm light; background falls away into haze. Broad lineless court, thin navy outlines on simple scenery, thick navy outlines on heroes and UI. Sparse moss on top of rim stones only, no flowers, busy texture or paving cracks across play floor.

TOP: exactly FIVE painted seat cards in a single strip across the top, deckled cream paper and hand-inked navy frames. First card reads exactly "Oskar · Fletcher"; second "Ada · Mitts"; third "Bot · Mender"; fourth and fifth show just "+". Use tiny silhouette icons on filled cards. Ada's seat is selected/open: immediately UNDER ADA'S CARD drops a small attached horizontal row of exactly SIX miniature hero cards, icon-led with small readable names "Fletcher", "Mitts", "Brew", "Mender", "Hook", "Coach". Their emblems: three quiver arrows/bow, big gloves, flask, megaphone, hook, whistle. A short hand-inked connection to Ada's card makes clear tapping this seat opens hero picking. Keep the dropdown small, cards subordinate to the play floor, no giant illustrated portraits.

GROUND: exactly FIVE low stone plates in a clearly countable ring, matching the five seats. Three occupied plates with the corresponding hero standing on them; two faint empty plates with subtle "+" marks. Arrange occupied Fletcher and Mitts plates adjacent and show their heroes MID-BONK across the plate edges, with a short glove motion arc; both still stand on their own plate so the five-seat mapping stays legible. Plenty of generous clear open floor around the ring for running and bonking. Do not duplicate either human elsewhere. No central fire, no shrine, no extra seats. Oskar as Fletcher: SLIM ROUND primitive silhouette with exactly THREE QUIVER ARROWS TILTED BACK, a hard beaked/horned brow and bow, worn muted teal enamel. Ada as Mitts: LOW SQUARE primitive silhouette, oversized angular glove fingers, low planted stance, small eyes under a hard brow, worn terracotta hide and enamel. Mender: SLIM BAR silhouette with a MEGAPHONE, NOT a robed humanoid wizard; translucent BLUE HOLOGRAM with floor visible through its body, no foot ring and NO overhead name. Human Oskar and Ada have their names overhead and distinct ink-rimmed foot discs with cream outer rings, clearly separate from the larger low stone seat plates. The bot's physical stone seat plate remains but it has NO personal ring. These are the ONLY three heroes in the world.

At the far right EDGE of the platform: one hefty simple chipped STONE GATE holding a softly lit pale-teal/cream portal, lit because party members exist. THROUGH the portal show a spatial glimpse of OVERTHROW LANES: flat sage lane, pale chunky stone walls, floating isles above warm peach cloud. A small inked "OVERTHROW" tag and floor arrow into the portal communicate entering the chosen map. No map selector, no GO button, no ready lock, no opposing teams, no health bars, no combat HUD.

Priorities: five seat cards + open hero dropdown; five physical stone plates; named humans bonking and unnamed ringless blue hologram; already-lit gate to Overthrow. A usable game lobby with a large quiet play floor, crisp primitive silhouettes, strong shapes and restrained ink. Render ONE finished frame, exactly 1536x1024.
